War Crime- Bangladesh (A documentary on Genocide by Pakistan 1971)
2014-12-02T00:00:47+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/war-crime-bangladesh-a-documentary-on-genocide-by-pakistan-1971-53395

Sheikh Mujib arrested and taken to West Pakistan. In exile, Awami League leaders proclaim the independence of the province of East Pakistan on 26th March. The new country is called Bangladesh. Just under 10 million Bangladeshis flee to India as troops from West Pakistan are defeated with Indian assistance.
